SDP.Item.Talent.SurplusEnergy.Name: Surplus Energy
SDP.Item.Talent.SurplusEnergy.Descriptio:
Through rigorous training and a deeper understanding of arcane forces, you have learned to channel magical energy more efficiently. Your mind now serves as a greater reservoir, capable of holding and controlling a larger amount of mystical power.

This mastery expands your magical reserves, allowing you to cast more spells before reaching your limits. Your Mental Strength directly fuels this increased capacity, permanently enhancing your magical potential.

Effect: add a multiplier of your Mental Strength to your maximum Mana pool.
SDP.Item.Talent.ambidextrous.Name: Ambidextrous
SDP.Item.Talent.ambidextrous.Description:
Through training or natural aptitude, you have learned to use your off-hand with remarkable ease. While most people struggle to perform precise actions with their secondary hand, you are able to compensate for this disadvantage far more effectively.

Whenever you perform an action relying solely on your off-hand, the usual penalty is reduced.

Effect: you suffer a -10 penalty on Tests performed exclusively with your off-hand instead of -20. If you acquire this Talent a second time, this penalty is removed entirely.
SDP.Item.Talent.animalaffinity.Name: Animal Affinity
SDP.Item.Talent.animalaffinity.Descripti:
Wild creatures instinctively perceive your presence as reassuring and non-threatening. Your natural affinity with the animal world inspires trust, even in wary beasts, which tend to remain calm around you and may occasionally follow you without fear.

Animals and other creatures that are not naturally aggressive remain peaceful in your presence unless a specific circumstance causes them to react differently. Pain, an immediate threat, an attack, strong territorial instincts, or the presence of offspring may still provoke hostility despite this gift.

Effect: creatures that are not naturally aggressive are automatically calm in your presence unless there is an obvious reason for them to behave otherwise.
SDP.Item.Talent.anatomist.Name: Anatomist
SDP.Item.Talent.anatomist.Description:
You have studied the anatomy of living creatures and know how to recognize their organs, joints, and weak points.

You gain a bonus to Tests related to studying the body, injuries, and living creatures.

In combat, if you identify a weak point on a creature, you may attempt to target it. This attack must aim at the relevant body part and suffers an additional penalty determined by the GM. In return, if the attack hits, it automatically inflicts a critical hit.
SDP.Item.Talent.fastreload.Name: Fast Reload
SDP.Item.Talent.fastreload.Description:
Max: Dexterity Bonus. Bonus: SL.

You have learned to handle ranged weapons with speed and efficiency. The reloading process has become second nature to you, allowing you to prepare your weapon for firing far faster than most marksmen.
SDP.Item.Talent.knowhow.Name: Know-How
SDP.Item.Talent.knowhow.Description:
You possess exceptional know-how that allows you to get the most out of your craft and your creations.

You gain a Success bonus equal to your Know-How level on all your Trade Tests.
SDP.Item.Talent.jackofalltrades.Name: Jack-of-All-Trades
SDP.Item.Talent.jackofalltrades.Descript:
Max: 1.

Your mastery of artisan techniques allows you to adapt to many areas of expertise.

Add any Know-How Skill to all of your careers.
SDP.Item.Talent.artist.Name: Artiste
SDP.Item.Talent.artist.Description:
You possess a natural talent for visual arts and can accurately depict people, places, or objects when given sufficient time and the proper materials. Whether sketching a wanted criminal, illustrating a manuscript, or creating a detailed map, your artistic skill can prove valuable in many situations.

The exact benefits provided by this ability depend on the circumstances and are determined by the GM.
SDP.Item.Talent.virtuosity.Name: Virtuosity
SDP.Item.Talent.virtuosity.Description:
You excel in your art and know how to captivate your audience.

You gain a bonus to Entertain, Musician, and Performance Tests per talent level.
SDP.Item.Talent.inspiring.Name: Inspiring
SDP.Item.Talent.inspiring.Description: After a successful use of Performance, Entertain, or Musician, your allies gain a +10 bonus to all of their Tests for a number of minutes equal to the SL achieved. The effect may represent courage, good spirits, motivation, or any other emotion stirred by your performance. On a failure, these emotions turn against them and the effect is reversed.
SDP.Item.Talent.affable.Name: Eloquent
SDP.Item.Talent.affable.Description:
You naturally inspire trust and know how to make yourself appreciated by those around you.

You gain +5 Sociability.
SDP.Item.Talent.attractive.Name: Magnetism
SDP.Item.Talent.attractive.Description:
Max: Sociability Bonus. Bonus: SL.

Whether through your appearance, your presence, your bearing, or the particular traits of your species, you naturally know how to highlight your assets.

When you make a Charm Test, add your level in this Talent to the roll result.
SDP.Item.Talent.authority.Name: Authority
SDP.Item.Talent.authority.Description:
You naturally inspire respect and obedience. Through your confidence, reputation, bearing, or the particular traits of your species, it is difficult to ignore your orders.

Characters whose Standing is lower than yours cannot resist your Command Tests. This effect does not apply to determined enemies, hostile creatures, or anyone who has a valid reason to refuse to obey you.
SDP.Item.Talent.nobility.Name: Nobility
SDP.Item.Talent.nobility.Description: You were born into nobility or were ennobled during your life. As long as your attire is appropriate to your rank, your social standing is naturally recognized. You are always considered to have a Standing higher than characters who do not possess this Talent. If your interlocutor also possesses the Nobility Talent, Standings are compared normally.
SDP.Item.Talent.mediator.Name: Mediator
SDP.Item.Talent.mediator.Description:
You know how to ease tensions and find common ground.

When you make a Test to calm a conflict or reconcile two parties, you may roll a number of times equal to your level in this Talent and keep the best result.
SDP.Item.Talent.snooper.Name: Snooper
SDP.Item.Talent.snooper.Description:
Max: Initiative Bonus. Bonus: SL.

You have an eye for spotting what others would overlook. Secret compartments, hidden passages, false bottoms, and carefully concealed objects naturally draw your attention.

When you search a room, container, vehicle, or any other environment, add your level in this Talent to the roll result.
SDP.Item.Talent.arcanediscipline.Name: Arcane Discipline (choose)
SDP.Item.Talent.arcanediscipline.Descrip:
Max: Intelligence Bonus. Bonus: Success.

You have perfected your understanding and mastery of this form of magic. Your experience allows you to better control errors and limit their consequences.

When you suffer a critical consequence with advanced magic of this specialization, it is treated as a minor consequence instead of a major consequence.

This Talent is required to learn and use the superior forms of this magic.

Specializations: Curative, Elemental (Fire, Water, Lightning, Earth, Air, Plant, Twilight), Invocation, Support, Modulation, Transformation, Clairvoyance, Necromancy, Demonology.
SDP.Item.Talent.arcanedisciplineair.Name: Arcane Discipline (Air)
SDP.Item.Talent.arcanepioneer.Name: Arcane Pioneer
SDP.Item.Talent.arcanepioneer.Descriptio:
You are among the rare mages who push the boundaries of magical knowledge. Your research allows you to better anticipate the difficulties linked to still unexplored theories.

When you create, modify, or use an experimental spell, reduce the penalties related to its experimental nature by 10 per level in this Talent.
SDP.Item.Talent.network.Name: Network (choose)
SDP.Item.Talent.network.Description:
You know the chosen organization perfectly—its customs, symbols, codes, and methods of communication. This familiarity allows you to easily identify its distinctive signs and understand their meaning.

You are also able to blend in more naturally with members of that group and recognize their behaviors, habits, and hierarchies. In ordinary situations, no Test is required to interpret or use these signs. Only unusual, secret, or particularly complex situations may require a Test.

Available groups: Criminals, Scouts, Merchants, Cults, Military, Independents, Magicians, Politicians, Scholars, and Artisans.

Effect: SL bonus.
SDP.Item.Talent.networkcriminals.Name: Network (Criminals)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkscouts.Name: Network (Scouts)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkmerchants.Name: Network (Merchants)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkcults.Name: Network (Cults)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkmilitary.Name: Network (Military)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkindependents.Name: Network (Independents)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkmagicians.Name: Network (Magicians)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkpoliticians.Name: Network (Politicians)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkscholars.Name: Network (Scholars)
SDP.Item.Talent.networkartisans.Name: Network (Artisans)
SDP.Item.Talent.sharpsenses.Name: Keen Senses (choose)
SDP.Item.Talent.sharpsenses.Description:
One of your senses is particularly keen, allowing you to perceive details that escape most people. The sense in question is chosen when you acquire this Talent.

You may make Perception Tests to detect elements that would normally be impossible to notice with that sense. Depending on the situation, the GM determines what information you are able to perceive. This may include an extremely faint sound, an unusual smell, a distant visual detail, a particular texture, or any other information related to the sense involved.

Available senses: Taste, Touch, Hearing, Smell, Sight.
SDP.Item.Talent.sharpsensestaste.Name: Keen Senses (Taste)
SDP.Item.Talent.sharpsensestouch.Name: Keen Senses (Touch)
SDP.Item.Talent.sharpsenseshearing.Name: Keen Senses (Hearing)
SDP.Item.Talent.sharpsensesSmell.Name: Keen Senses (Smell)
SDP.Item.Talent.sharpsensesSight.Name: Keen Senses (Sight)
SDP.Item.Talent.nightvision.Name: Night Vision
SDP.Item.Talent.nightvision.Description:
You are able to see in darkness far better than most creatures.

As long as a faint natural light source is present (moonlight, starlight, bioluminescence, etc.), you can see clearly up to 20 meters per level of Night Vision.
SDP.Item.Talent.notwithme.Name: Not with Me
SDP.Item.Talent.notwithme.Description:
You refuse to let someone die as long as there is the slightest hope.

Once per session, you may automatically stabilize a person without making a Test. This may allow them to survive a mortal wound, a failed Healing attempt, or any similar event, at the GM's discretion.
SDP.Item.Talent.babble.Name: Babble
SDP.Item.Talent.babble.Description:
Babble consists of overwhelming a target with a continuous stream of words in order to distract, confuse, or prevent them from thinking clearly. Whether through endless chatter, trivial subjects, or confusing explanations, your goal is to lose your listener in your speech.

To use this Talent, make an opposed Charm vs. Intelligence Test. On a success, the target gains 1 Stunned Condition. Each additional level of this Talent inflicts 1 additional Stunned Condition.

While affected by these Conditions, the target remains captivated by your speech and struggles to focus on anything else. If you stop talking, all Stunned Conditions caused by this Talent immediately end.

The same target generally cannot be affected by Babble more than once per scene, or more often at the GM's discretion. After a first attempt, most people quickly see through your ploy and become less receptive to this kind of distraction.
SDP.Item.Talent.readwrite.Name: Read / Write
SDP.Item.Talent.readwrite.Description: You are able to read and write in the languages you speak.
SDP.Item.Talent.opportunist.Name: Opportunist
SDP.Item.Talent.opportunist.Description:
You have a natural instinct for spotting opportunities before others do.

When your character could reasonably identify an interesting opportunity, the GM may inform you of it. This may involve a material, social, political, or financial advantage, depending on the context.
SDP.Item.Talent.perceptive.Name: Brilliant
SDP.Item.Talent.perceptive.Description:
Your mind quickly analyzes situations and establishes links that many fail to perceive.

You gain +5 Intelligence.
SDP.Item.Talent.imperturbable.Name: Resolute
SDP.Item.Talent.imperturbable.Descriptio:
Your will remains unshakable, even in the most trying situations.

You gain +5 Willpower.
SDP.Item.Talent.lightningreflexes.Name: Feline
SDP.Item.Talent.lightningreflexes.Descri:
Your flexibility, balance, and movement speed are remarkable.

You gain +5 Agility.
SDP.Item.Talent.foxtread.Name: Fox Tread
SDP.Item.Talent.foxtread.Description:
You have learned to move discreetly through natural environments, avoiding attention and limiting the traces you leave behind.

When moving through the wild, you gain an advantage when hiding, moving unnoticed, or concealing the signs of your passage.
SDP.Item.Talent.determined.Name: Combat Sense
SDP.Item.Talent.determined.Description:
Melee combat has become second nature to you. Whether through innate talent or years of experience, you instinctively know how to gain the upper hand over your opponent.

You gain +5 Melee Ability per talent level.
SDP.Item.Talent.hardy.Name: Hardy
SDP.Item.Talent.hardy.Description:
Your exceptional constitution allows you to withstand more wounds than most people.

You gain additional Health Points equal to your Toughness Bonus, multiplied by this Talent's level. If your Toughness Bonus increases later, the Health Points granted by this Talent increase as well.
SDP.Item.Talent.hardhead.Name: Hard Head
SDP.Item.Talent.hardhead.Description:
Max: Toughness.

You have learned to shrug off blows and stay conscious where others would collapse.

You gain a SL bonus per talent level when resisting the Stunned condition.
SDP.Item.Talent.tireless.Name: Tireless
SDP.Item.Talent.tireless.Description:
You are able to keep pushing yourself where most people would collapse from exhaustion.

Once per day per Tireless level, you can ignore one Exhausted condition you would otherwise gain.
SDP.Item.Talent.sturdy.Name: Sturdy
SDP.Item.Talent.sturdy.Description:
You are accustomed to carrying heavy loads, whether through physical strength, endurance, or years of effort.

Add your Strength Bonus and Toughness Bonus to your maximum encumbrance, multiplied by this Talent's level.
SDP.Item.Talent.strongarms.Name: Strong Arms
SDP.Item.Talent.strongarms.Description:
Physical labor has made you particularly enduring.

You gain a bonus to Tests requiring carrying, moving, pushing, or pulling loads.
SDP.Item.Talent.waterman.Name: Man of the Waters
SDP.Item.Talent.waterman.Description:
You are accustomed to living and working aboard a vessel. Rolling seas, waves, currents, and foul weather no longer throw you off balance the way they do most people.

You may ignore all negative modifiers to Navigation Tests resulting from weather conditions, the vessel's movement, or any similar situation.
SDP.Item.Talent.surgery.Name: Surgery
SDP.Item.Talent.surgery.Description:
You are trained in surgical techniques and capable of performing complex operations to treat the most serious wounds.

You may treat any Injury requiring surgical intervention. Surgery generally requires an extended Test, with difficulty depending on the severity of the operation. Each failure may cause a loss of Wounds and inflict the Hemorrhaging condition.

After the operation, the patient must succeed on an Accessible Resistance Test (+20) or gain a minor Infection if no appropriate disinfectant was used.
SDP.Item.Talent.verystrong.Name: Raw Power
SDP.Item.Talent.verystrong.Description:
Whether it comes from a natural gift or intensive training, your physical power is excellent.

You gain +5 Strength.
SDP.Item.Talent.veryresistant.Name: Very Resistant
SDP.Item.Talent.veryresistant.Descriptio:
Your body withstands effort, wounds, and fatigue with remarkable tenacity.

You gain +5 Toughness.
SDP.Item.Talent.worldear.Name: Ear of the World
SDP.Item.Talent.worldear.Description:
You maintain a vast network of contacts, informants, and acquaintances across different regions. These connections often allow you to obtain information before others.

When you arrive in an important settlement, you may make an appropriate Test to learn a local rumor, a recent event, an influential figure, or any other useful information determined by the GM.
SDP.Item.Talent.experteye.Name: Expert's Eye
SDP.Item.Talent.experteye.Description:
You are accustomed to examining and assessing valuable objects. With a simple glance, you are often able to estimate their quality, origin, rarity, or possible flaws.

The GM may also provide you with additional information regarding an object's craftsmanship, authenticity, or provenance when relevant.
SDP.Item.Talent.wealthy.Name: Wealthy
SDP.Item.Talent.wealthy.Description:
You possess personal wealth, substantial income, or resources that ensure considerable financial comfort. It is rare for you to be truly short of money, even when times are hard.

Whenever you earn money, including through Income activities, you gain +1 additional gold coin per level of this Talent. However, this bonus must remain consistent with the situation: a small reward or a few copper coins do not miraculously turn into a fortune.

The GM remains free to determine when this bonus applies appropriately.
SDP.Item.Talent.alacrity.Name: Celerity
SDP.Item.Talent.alacrity.Description:
Your natural reflexes and speed of action let you act before most opponents.

You gain +5 Initiative.
SDP.Item.Talent.lucky.Name: Lucky
SDP.Item.Talent.lucky.Description:
Fate seems to watch over you and guide your steps in important moments. Whether through a fortunate coincidence, an unexpected stroke of luck, or a simple hunch, events often tend to turn in your favor.

Your maximum Fortune Points increase by an amount equal to the number of times you have acquired this Talent. Your maximum Fortune Point reserve is therefore equal to your current Destiny Points, plus your Lucky level.
SDP.Item.Talent.intriguer.Name: Intriguer
SDP.Item.Talent.intriguer.Description:
You understand power games, hidden alliances, and rivalries that shape organizations and societies. Where others see only isolated events, you are able to discern the interests, influences, and maneuvers operating behind the scenes.

Once per session, you may ask the GM a question regarding a political situation, an organization, or a network of influence. The GM then makes a secret Intelligence Test and reveals information, clues, or observations based on the SL achieved.

The intelligence obtained is not always complete, but it often allows you to better understand the true stakes of a situation.
SDP.Item.Talent.liar.Name: Liar
SDP.Item.Talent.liar.Description:
You possess a remarkable talent for manipulating the truth. Lies, half-truths, and genuine facts blend in your speech with such ease that it becomes extremely difficult to distinguish what is true from what is false.

When you use the Charm Skill to lie or deceive someone, your listeners cannot use Intuition to detect whether your words are suspicious or inconsistent. They must rely on other evidence, testimony, or circumstances to question what you say.

This does not make your lies automatically believable, but it becomes much harder to perceive the deception hidden within them.
SDP.Item.Talent.negotiator.Name: Negotiator
SDP.Item.Talent.negotiator.Description:
You know the inner workings of commerce and how to conduct negotiations to your advantage. Thanks to your experience, you regularly obtain better terms when buying or selling goods.

When you use the Haggle Skill, prices obtained are improved by an additional 10% in your favor, whether you are trying to buy cheaper or sell for more.

The GM remains free to limit this advantage when a seller cannot reasonably sell at a loss or when circumstances make any negotiation difficult.
SDP.Item.Talent.swindle.Name: Swindle
SDP.Item.Talent.swindle.Description:
You know how to discreetly skim a small share of the wealth that passes through your hands. Cooked books, forgotten commissions, or hidden profits—you have learned to benefit from transactions without drawing attention.

Each time you earn money, whether in play or through an Income activity, you may make an opposed Intelligence Test against your employer, if you have one. On a success, you divert an additional sum whose value depends on the importance of the transaction, at the GM's discretion.

If your employer achieves +6 SL or more than you, your scheme is discovered. You keep the money obtained, but the consequences of your swindle are left to the GM's judgment. In all other cases, you fail to divert any money.
SDP.Item.Talent.handyman.Name: Handyman
SDP.Item.Talent.handyman.Description:
You have a knack for understanding how things work and finding solutions where others see only broken parts. Through ingenuity and experience, you can repair a wide variety of equipment even without specialized training.

Effect: when attempting to repair a damaged or broken item, all non-magical Know-How Skills are treated as Basic Skills for you.
SDP.Item.Talent.sixthsense.Name: Sixth Sense
SDP.Item.Talent.sixthsense.Description:
You possess a particularly keen instinct that warns you when something is wrong.

The GM may inform you that danger is approaching, that a presence is watching you, or that an unusual event is about to occur. This information is generally obtained following a secret Intuition Test made on your behalf.

In addition, if you succeed on an Intuition Test, you may ignore the effects of Surprise.
SDP.Item.Talent.magicaffinity.Name: Magic Affinity
SDP.Item.Talent.magicaffinity.Descriptio:
Magic is naturally part of your heritage. Whether through an ancestral gift or a particular sensitivity to mystical forces, you maintain an innate connection to magic.

Choose a type of magic. It is now integrated into all of your careers.
SDP.Item.Talent.endrelspirit.Name: Spirit of the Endrels
SDP.Item.Talent.endrelspirit.Description:
The bond that unites Endrels goes beyond words and distance. You are naturally able to recognize the presence of your kind and sense their proximity.

As long as an Endrel is nearby, you may spot them and communicate with them without needing to make any Test.

If you seek to locate or contact a distant Endrel, an Intelligence Test may be required. The GM applies appropriate modifiers according to distance, obstacles, or particular circumstances.
SDP.Item.Talent.orientationsense.Name: Sense of Orientation
SDP.Item.Talent.orientationsense.Descrip:
You possess a natural sense of direction and know how to read the signs around you to find your way.

When outdoors, you can generally determine your direction using the stars, the sun, vegetation, or other natural landmarks without needing to make a Test.

You may treat your Orientation Tests as successful, except in particular circumstances such as an unknown location, a vast building, an underground network, a cave, or any situation where usual landmarks are absent or misleading.
SDP.Item.Talent.lipreading.Name: Lip Reading
SDP.Item.Talent.lipreading.Description: You can read a person's lips and understand their words, provided you have a clear view of their mouth.
SDP.Item.Talent.lightfinger.Name: Dexterity
SDP.Item.Talent.lightfinger.Description:
Your hands perform exceptionally precise motions, whether manipulating an object or carrying out a delicate task.

You gain +5 Dexterity.
SDP.Item.Talent.felineagility.Name: Feline Agility
SDP.Item.Talent.felineagility.Descriptio:
You possess exceptional agility, similar to that of cats, which allows you to cushion your falls and land with remarkable grace.

Each time you fall, make an Athletics Test. On a success, reduce the fall distance by 1 meter, plus 1 additional meter per SL achieved, for the purpose of calculating damage.
SDP.Item.Talent.menacing.Name: Menacing
SDP.Item.Talent.menacing.Description:
Your mere presence is sometimes enough to make even the bravest hesitate. Whether through your build, your gaze, or your reputation, you naturally inspire fear.

When you use the Intimidation Skill, gain an SL bonus equal to your Menacing level.
SDP.Item.Talent.robust.Name: Robust
SDP.Item.Talent.robust.Description:
You are particularly resilient and able to withstand wounds that would put others out of action.

Reduce all Damage taken by 1 per Robust level. However, you always suffer a minimum of 1 Wound, regardless of the source of the damage.
SDP.Item.Talent.characterjudge.Name: Character Judge
SDP.Item.Talent.characterjudge.Descripti:
Max: Initiative Bonus. Bonus: SL.

You can quickly determine what kind of person you are dealing with.

After a few minutes of conversation, you may ask the GM one question about an individual's motivations, reliability, or general intentions. The player is entitled to one question per Talent level without needing to roll.
SDP.Item.Talent.scholar.Name: Scholar
SDP.Item.Talent.scholar.Description:
Max: Intelligence Bonus. Bonus: SL.

You have devoted much of your life to study and the acquisition of knowledge. Your erudition covers many fields and allows you to make connections that others would not notice.

You gain an SL bonus equal to your Scholar level on all Lore Tests corresponding to knowledge your character possesses.

As with any Lore Test, the GM may provide additional information depending on your degree of success.
SDP.Item.Talent.alleycat.Name: Alley Cat
SDP.Item.Talent.alleycat.Description:
Max: Agility Bonus. Bonus: SL.

You are at ease in urban environments. When you use Stealth (Urban), add your Talent level as an SL bonus.
SDP.Item.Talent.breaking.Name: Breaking
SDP.Item.Talent.breaking.Description:
Max: Strength Bonus. Bonus: SL.

You know where to strike and how to apply enough force to break through obstacles quickly.

When you attempt to break or force an inanimate object, such as a door, window, chest, or similar obstacle, you gain a bonus of +1 SL or +1 damage per Breaking level.
SDP.Item.Talent.briber.Name: Briber
SDP.Item.Talent.briber.Description:
You know who to talk to, how much to offer, and how to present a bribe without arousing suspicion.

When you attempt to corrupt someone, the GM may reduce the base cost of the bribe by 10% per Briber level.
SDP.Item.Talent.instinctivecombat.Name: Instinctive Combat
SDP.Item.Talent.instinctivecombat.Descri:
Your reflexes are exceptionally fast, allowing you to react before most of your opponents.

When determining your Combat Initiative, increase your Initiative by 10 per Instinctive Combat level.
SDP.Item.Talent.elusive.Name: Elusive
SDP.Item.Talent.elusive.Description:
You have developed an exceptional talent for avoiding blows and escaping dangerous situations.

You gain +0.5 Dodge.
SDP.Item.Talent.steadfastdefense.Name: Steadfast Defense
SDP.Item.Talent.steadfastdefense.Descrip:
Battle has taught you to read your opponents' movements and deflect their attacks with efficiency.

You gain +0.5 Parry.
SDP.Item.Talent.woundingstrike.Name: Wounding Strike
SDP.Item.Talent.woundingstrike.Descripti:
You know how to spot gaps in your opponents' defenses and strike where it hurts most.

When you inflict a Wound, its severity increases by one level.
SDP.Item.Talent.sidestep.Name: Sidestep
SDP.Item.Talent.sidestep.Description:
You have a knack for being where enemy weapons are not.

If you use Dodge to defend against an attack and win the opposed Test, you may move up to 2 meters as you dive out of reach, meaning you are no longer Engaged. None of your opponents gain a free Attack when you make this Sidestep.
SDP.Item.Talent.feint.Name: Feint
SDP.Item.Talent.feint.Description:
You know how to deceive your opponents' vigilance by feigning an attack to create an opening.

You may use a Feint as an Action against an opponent wielding a weapon. Make an opposed Melee Test using the Skills appropriate to the weapons involved.

If you win the opposition and attack the same target before the end of the next round, you may add the SL achieved on the Feint to the result of your next attack.
SDP.Item.Talent.knockdown.Name: Knockdown
SDP.Item.Talent.knockdown.Description:
You have learned to unbalance your opponents and send them to the ground at the right moment.

You gain bonuses when you attempt to knock a target down. A grounded enemy must normally use an Action to stand up. If in contact with an opponent, they must beware of exposing themselves to an opportunity attack. Depending on the creature, it may be more or less difficult to knock down, especially if it moves on four legs.
SDP.Item.Talent.quickshot.Name: Quick Shot
SDP.Item.Talent.quickshot.Description:
You are able to react in a fraction of a second and fire before combat resumes its normal course.

If you have a loaded ranged weapon, you may make a shot before the start of the next round, before any other action. Resolve this attack normally, applying the usual modifiers.

Using Quick Shot consumes both your Action and Movement on your next turn. These are considered already used when your initiative comes up.

If several characters use Quick Shot, the one with the most levels in this Talent acts first. In case of a tie, the shots are resolved simultaneously.
SDP.Item.Talent.disarm.Name: Disarm
SDP.Item.Talent.disarm.Description:
You know how to exploit the slightest opening to wrest a weapon from your opponent's hands.

As an Action, you may make an opposed Melee Test against your target. On a success, they drop one of the weapons they are holding, which falls to the ground in a direction determined by the GM.

The greater your success, the more control you have over where the weapon lands. With an exceptional success, you may even recover the weapon directly, provided you have a free hand.
SDP.Item.Talent.riposte.Name: Riposte
SDP.Item.Talent.riposte.Description:
You turn your defense into an attack and seize the slightest opening left by your opponent.

If your weapon has the Fast trait, you may make a Riposte when an enemy attacks you. This attack inflicts its normal damage, as if it were your own Action.

You may make a number of Ripostes per round equal to your Riposte level.
SDP.Item.Talent.twoweaponfighting.Name: Two-Weapon Fighting
SDP.Item.Talent.twoweaponfighting.Descri:
You have learned to wield two weapons simultaneously and coordinate your attacks with efficiency.

When equipped with two weapons, you may attack with both as part of the same Action. Attacks made in this way suffer a -20 penalty to hit.

The first level of this Talent allows you to fight with two weapons. The next two levels each reduce the to-hit penalty by 10.
SDP.Item.Talent.reactivestrike.Name: Reactive Strike
SDP.Item.Talent.reactivestrike.Descripti:
Your quick reactions have allowed you to drop many enemies before they even had time to draw their weapons.

When you are Charged, you may attempt an Average Reflexes Test (+0) to immediately gain a free Attack outside the normal turn sequence. This attack is resolved with whatever weapon you hold in your main hand.

You may make as many Reactive Strikes during a Round as you have Levels in this Talent, but you may only attack each Charging individual once.
SDP.Item.Talent.guardian.Name: Guardian
SDP.Item.Talent.guardian.Description:
You are accustomed to placing yourself between danger and those you protect, taking blows in their stead when the situation demands it.

When you interpose yourself to protect an ally, you gain a Parry bonus equal to your Guardian level.
SDP.Item.Talent.flurryofblows.Name: Flurry of Blows
SDP.Item.Talent.flurryofblows.Descriptio:
You chain attacks with impressive speed, maintaining constant pressure on your opponents.

Once per round, when you hit an enemy in melee, you may immediately spend all of your Movement to make an additional attack.

This Talent is incompatible with the Kangaroo sign as well as with weapons wielded exclusively with two hands.
SDP.Item.Talent.fearless.Name: Fearless
SDP.Item.Talent.fearless.Description:
You show exceptional courage, or a recklessness that defies common sense. Where others hesitate, you press forward.

You gain a bonus to Tests made to resist fear, whether inspired by a creature, an individual, or a particularly terrifying situation.
SDP.Item.Talent.stunningstrike.Name: Stunning Strike
SDP.Item.Talent.stunningstrike.Descripti:
You know precisely where to strike to stun an opponent or put them out of action with a few well-placed blows.

When you use a bludgeoning weapon, it automatically gains the Stunning trait. If the weapon already has this trait, you gain a +10 bonus per Stunning Strike level when attempting to stun a target by hitting them in the head.
SDP.Item.Talent.smelltrouble.Name: Smell Trouble
SDP.Item.Talent.smelltrouble.Description:
You have learned to recognize the first signs that trouble is brewing. Whether through experience, instinct, or training, you are difficult to catch off guard.

You may make an Intuition Test to spot individuals seeking to harm you or cause trouble. This Test may be opposed if the target tries to conceal their intentions, and the GM may roll it secretly so as not to reveal a possible failure.

If a person you spotted subsequently enters combat, you may ignore any Surprised condition they would normally have inflicted on you.
SDP.Item.Talent.surefooted.Name: Sure-Footed
SDP.Item.Talent.surefooted.Description:
You are used to keeping your balance even when your opponents try to send you to the ground.

Whenever you gain the Prone condition, you may make an Average Athletics Test (+0). On a success, you immediately land back on your feet and ignore the usual effects of that condition.

The GM may apply modifiers to this Test depending on the force of the blow or the circumstances that caused the fall.
SDP.Item.Talent.powerfulstrike.Name: Powerful Strike
SDP.Item.Talent.powerfulstrike.Descripti:
You know how to focus all your strength into your attacks to deliver particularly devastating blows.

You inflict additional damage equal to your Powerful Strike level with your melee weapons.
SDP.Item.Talent.runner.Name: Runner
SDP.Item.Talent.runner.Description:
You are accustomed to covering long distances or have undergone rigorous physical training. Your endurance and stride allow you to move faster than most people.

You gain +1 Movement.
SDP.Item.Talent.preciseshot.Name: Precise Shot
SDP.Item.Talent.preciseshot.Description:
You know how to spot your opponents' weak points and place your shots where they will be most effective.

You inflict additional damage equal to your Precise Shot level with all your ranged weapons.
SDP.Item.Talent.exceptionalmarksman.Name: Exceptional Marksman
SDP.Item.Talent.exceptionalmarksman.Desc:
Your skill with ranged weapons is remarkable. Whether it comes from an innate gift or years of practice, you know how to place your shots with deadly precision.

You gain +5 Ranged Ability.
SDP.Item.Talent.calculatedshot.Name: Calculated Shot
SDP.Item.Talent.calculatedshot.Descripti:
You know how to shoot accurately at long range and compensate for the difficulties caused by distance.

For each level of Calculated Shot, reduce range penalties by 10.
SDP.Item.Talent.localizedshot.Name: Localized Shot
SDP.Item.Talent.localizedshot.Descriptio:
You are able to precisely aim at the most vulnerable parts of your target.

Reduce the location penalty by 10 when you make a ranged attack targeting a specific body part.
SDP.Item.Talent.criminal.Name: Criminal
SDP.Item.Talent.criminal.Description:
You live outside the law and earn your living through more or less illegal activities.

When you perform an Income Activity, you gain 2×, 3×, or 4× the usual amount, depending on your Criminal level.

Your reputation often precedes you. Gang tattoos, shady associates, a threatening appearance, or a simply bad reputation: local authorities are naturally suspicious of you and regularly question your intentions.

The higher your Criminal level, the harder this reputation is to ignore. The exact consequences are determined by the GM.

With the GM's approval, you can remove Criminal levels and recover the same amount of XP as their purchase cost.
SDP.Item.Talent.creativity.Name: Creativity
SDP.Item.Talent.creativity.Description:
You are accustomed to experimenting and designing extraordinary objects.

When attempting to create an innovative object, reduce the difficulty penalty by 10 per talent level.
SDP.Item.Talent.climber.Name: Climber
SDP.Item.Talent.climber.Description:
You are an exceptional climber, able to find handholds where others see only an impassable wall.

You gain a bonus to Climbing Tests, regardless of the surface.
SDP.Item.Talent.chameleon.Name: Chameleon
SDP.Item.Talent.chameleon.Description:
You excel at imitating the appearance and mannerisms of others. With the right posture, a few changes of expression, and appropriate clothing, you can pass yourself off as someone else.

When a person knows you little or does not know the person being imitated, no particular check is generally required. However, if you interact with someone who knows well the person whose identity you are assuming, a Test will be required with modifiers determined by the GM.

Identity impersonation attempts generally rely on an Entertain (Acting) Test, whose difficulty depends on the situation, the credibility of the disguise, and your interlocutor's vigilance.
SDP.Item.Talent.goodlegs.Name: Good Legs
SDP.Item.Talent.goodlegs.Description:
Your legs are powerful and allow you to perform impressive leaps.

Add your Good Legs level to your SL for all Athletics Tests involving a jump.
SDP.Item.Talent.lockpicker.Name: Experienced Lockpicker
SDP.Item.Talent.lockpicker.Description:
You are accustomed to dealing with all kinds of locks and know the subtleties of many locking mechanisms.

You gain a bonus to Lockpicking Tests when attempting to open a lock.
SDP.Item.Talent.nimblefingers.Name: Nimble Fingers
SDP.Item.Talent.nimblefingers.Descriptio:
You can move your hands with remarkable dexterity, performing manipulations that often go unnoticed.

Passers-by do not benefit from any passive Perception Test to notice your use of the Sleight of Hand skill. They can only oppose your Sleight of Hand Tests if they actively suspect you or watch your movements closely.

Note that this does not make you invisible. Guards, militia, busybodies, or anyone actively watching their surroundings can still notice your actions.
SDP.Item.Talent.experiencedseeker.Name: Experienced Seeker
SDP.Item.Talent.experiencedseeker.Descri:
You know where to look and which clues to observe to find what others would overlook.

When you search for, gather, or identify something related to one of your Lore skills or Trade skills, you gain an SL bonus.
SDP.Item.Talent.trapper.Name: Trapper
SDP.Item.Talent.trapper.Description:
You are accustomed to spotting traps and the signs that reveal their presence.

You may make a Perception Test to automatically detect nearby traps without explicitly declaring your search. The GM may roll this Test secretly so as not to reveal a possible failure.
SDP.Item.Talent.flee.Name: Flee
SDP.Item.Talent.flee.Description:
When your survival is at stake, you can run faster than most people.

Your Movement is considered 1 higher when you attempt to flee from danger or escape a pursuer.
SDP.Item.Talent.weatherhardened.Name: Weather-Hardened
SDP.Item.Talent.weatherhardened.Descript:
You have learned to live and travel in harsh weather conditions.

All penalties linked to the environment (cold, rain, heat, storms, high winds, etc.) are reduced by 10 per talent level.
SDP.Item.Talent.skinner.Name: Skinner
SDP.Item.Talent.skinner.Description:
You know how to efficiently recover resources from creatures you hunt or kill.

You gain an SL bonus equal to your Skinner level on all Tests to harvest meat, leather, fur, fangs, horns, or any similar material.
SDP.Item.Talent.animalinstinct.Name: Animal Instinct
SDP.Item.Talent.animalinstinct.Descripti:
You instinctively understand animal behavior and know how to interpret their reactions.

The GM may warn you of an animal's likely intentions or reactions. The information obtained depends on the species involved and the situation. When you correctly anticipate an animal's behavior, you generally have enough time to react before it does.
SDP.Item.Talent.hunterseye.Name: Hunter's Eye
SDP.Item.Talent.hunterseye.Description:
Nothing escapes your gaze when it comes to following a trail.

You gain a bonus to Tracking Tests and spot traces, signs of passage, and evidence of presence left by a creature or individual more easily.
SDP.Item.Talent.goodwalker.Name: Good Walker
SDP.Item.Talent.goodwalker.Description:
You are accustomed to traveling across difficult terrain and know how to avoid obstacles that slow most travelers.

Reduce all Movement penalties linked to a specific type of terrain. This may include coastlines, deserts, marshes, rocky ground, tundras, wooded regions, or any similar environment.
SDP.Item.Talent.gamesmaster.Name: Games Master
SDP.Item.Talent.gamesmaster.Description:
You are accustomed to games of chance. Whether through experience, keen observation, or a few disreputable tricks, you know how to fleece less experienced players.

You gain an SL bonus on all Gamble Tests as well as Sleight of Hand Tests made in the context of a game of chance.
SDP.Item.Talent.precisestrike.Name: Precise Strike
SDP.Item.Talent.precisestrike.Descriptio:
You are able to place your attacks with remarkable accuracy, even when aiming at a specific part of the body.

Reduce the penalty linked to targeted location by an amount equal to your precise strike level. This Talent can never turn that penalty into a bonus.
SDP.Item.Talent.seasonedhandler.Name: Seasoned Handler
SDP.Item.Talent.seasonedhandler.Descript:
You know how to push your mounts to give their best, even in the most demanding situations.

When you control an animal, whether you are riding or driving a team, it gains +1 Movement as long as you use a whip or any other appropriate means to spur it on.
SDP.Item.Talent.devastatingcharge.Name: Devastating Charge
SDP.Item.Talent.devastatingcharge.Descri:
You are trained to fight during cavalry charges.

You gain a +1 bonus to hit in melee during a mounted charge.
SDP.Item.Talent.mounteddodge.Name: Mounted Dodge
SDP.Item.Talent.mounteddodge.Description:
Accustomed to guiding your mount through the heart of battle, you use its movements to avoid attacks.

Reduce Evasion penalties when you are mounted.
SDP.Item.Talent.mountmaster.Name: Master of Mounts
SDP.Item.Talent.mountmaster.Description:
You have mastered the art of riding.

Penalties linked to using an unfamiliar mount or lacking the appropriate Riding specialization are ignored.

You may also attempt to mount a creature that has never been trained.
SDP.Item.Talent.warcompanion.Name: War Companion
SDP.Item.Talent.warcompanion.Description:
Your mount is trained to fight at your side.

A trained mount may make an attack during the same turn as you.
SDP.Item.Talent.seasonedtraveler.Name: Seasoned Traveler
SDP.Item.Talent.seasonedtraveler.Descrip:
Your curiosity has led you to travel through many regions and discover their customs, history, and inhabitants.

Add Lore (Region) to all of your careers.
SDP.Item.Talent.hardened.Name: Hardened
SDP.Item.Talent.hardened.Description:
Max: Toughness Bonus.

Your body is able to withstand wounds that would put others out of action.

You gain +1 Wound Threshold.
SDP.Item.Talent.pathsniffer.Name: Path Sniffer
SDP.Item.Talent.pathsniffer.Description:
You have a natural instinct for finding your way, even in the most complex places.

Whether in a city, a tunnel network, a ruin, or a forest, you more easily spot passages, shortcuts, and alternate routes. When searching for a path or a way out, the GM may grant you a bonus to Orientation, Perception, or Reflection Tests, depending on the situation.
SDP.Item.Talent.stubborn.Name: Stubborn
SDP.Item.Talent.stubborn.Description:
Your will is exceptional and you refuse to give up, no matter what difficulties you encounter.

Add your Stubborn level to the maximum of your Determination reserve.
SDP.Item.Talent.puresoul.Name: Pure Soul
SDP.Item.Talent.puresoul.Description:
Your mind naturally resists corrupting influences and forces that seek to alter your soul.

You gain +1 SL per Pure Soul level on Composure Tests made to resist the effects of corruption.
SDP.Item.Talent.frightening.Name: Frightening
SDP.Item.Talent.frightening.Description:
Your appearance, reputation, or mere presence is enough to make others uncomfortable.

If you wish, you possess a Fear Rating of 1. This rating increases by +1 each time you take this Talent again.
SDP.Item.Talent.spelltrace.Name: Spell Trace
SDP.Item.Talent.spelltrace.Description:
You are able to perceive the magical residue left behind by a spell after it is cast.

Using your Perception, you can spot traces of magic on a person, an object, or in the environment. The older these traces are, the harder they are to identify or trace to their origin.
SDP.Item.Talent.artifactdetection.Name: Artifact Detection
SDP.Item.Talent.artifactdetection.Descri:
You have learned to recognize the signs revealing the presence of magic in an object.

When you suspect an object is magical, you may make a Perception Test. On a success, you determine whether the object has a magical nature. Each SL achieved may also reveal a property, effect, or particular trait of the artifact.

As a general rule, you may only make this Test once per artifact.
SDP.Item.Talent.magicresistance.Name: Magic Resistant
SDP.Item.Talent.magicresistance.Descript:
Max: Willpower Bonus.

Your mind, body, or soul offer natural resistance to magical energies.

The SL of any Spell affecting you is reduced by 1 per Magic Resistance level. This reduction may be sufficient to cause a spell to fail.

When a spell affects multiple targets, only the highest Magic Resistance value among the affected targets is taken into account when modifying the spell's SL.
SDP.Item.Talent.flowmastery.Name: Flow Mastery
SDP.Item.Talent.flowmastery.Description: You master the flow of energy, whether it comes from the world around you or courses through your own body. By channeling it, you strengthen every movement, improving both your defense and your strikes. Your Dodge is now based on your Intelligence. In addition, your melee attacks gain a damage bonus equal to half your Willpower bonus (rounded down). Each action benefiting from this talent costs you 1 mana point.
SDP.Item.Talent.divinelink.Name: Divine Link
SDP.Item.Talent.divinelink.Description:
You are particularly sensitive to the manifestations of the gods and their influence on the world.

At any time, you may make an Intuition Test to determine whether a god is responsible for an event, phenomenon, object, place, or a person's condition. Depending on your success, the GM may reveal clues about the presence or influence of a divine power nearby.
SDP.Item.Talent.preservation.Name: Preservation
SDP.Item.Talent.preservation.Description:
Your body naturally resists hardships that would affect most people.

Once per game session, you may automatically succeed on the first Test made to resist a threat such as Poison, Disease, Fatigue, or any similar effect.
SDP.Item.Talent.tribune.Name: Tribune
SDP.Item.Talent.tribune.Description:
You know how to captivate a crowd, draw attention, and get your message across to a large number of people.

When you use the Charm Skill to influence multiple individuals, the number of targets affected is multiplied by x5. This multiplier doubles at each Orator level: x5, x10, x20, x40, x80, etc.
SDP.Item.Talent.charismatictribune.Name: Charismatic Tribune
SDP.Item.Talent.charismatictribune.Descr:
You know how to find the right words to captivate an assembly and rally a crowd to your cause.

When you make a Charm Test before an audience or a crowd, you gain an SL bonus equal to your Charismatic Tribune level.
SDP.Item.Talent.studious.Name: Studious
SDP.Item.Talent.studious.Description:
You spend much of your time reading, studying, and consulting all kinds of writings.

You benefit from an advantage when conducting research in books, archives, libraries, records, or any other written document.
SDP.Item.Talent.ardentfervor.Name: Ardent Fervor
SDP.Item.Talent.ardentfervor.Description:
When you defend your convictions, your faith, or a cause dear to your heart, your words are filled with contagious passion.

When you use the Orator Talent to defend your cause, your situation, or your religion, you may double your Fellowship to determine the number of people influenced.
SDP.Item.Talent.tenacity.Name: Tenacity
SDP.Item.Talent.tenacity.Description:
You refuse to give in to pain and keep fighting despite wounds that would have stopped other combatants.

When you would suffer a Wound, you may reduce its effects. You may use this Talent a number of times per session or per combat equal to your Tenacity level.
SDP.Item.Talent.arcanereflexes.Name: Arcane Reflexes
SDP.Item.Talent.arcanereflexes.Descripti:
You are capable of invoking magic in the heat of battle with disconcerting speed.

At any time, you may cast a Spell of power 5 or less for free by spending your next Movement or your next turn.
SDP.Item.Talent.multipleconsciousness.De:
Your mind is capable of following several streams of magic simultaneously.

You may sustain multiple concentration spells at the same time, within the limits defined by the rules or the GM.
SDP.Item.Talent.unflappablemind.Name: Unflappable Mind
SDP.Item.Talent.unflappablemind.Descript:
You maintain your concentration even in the heart of chaos and the most violent battles.

You gain a bonus to Calm Tests made to sustain your concentration spells.
SDP.Item.Talent.mentallibrary.Name: Mental Library
SDP.Item.Talent.mentallibrary.Descriptio:
Your mind is a true library of knowledge accumulated through your reading and experiences.

Once per scene, you may ask the GM whether your character possesses relevant knowledge about the current situation. You may ask one additional question per Mental Library level, provided the GM considers that this information could reasonably be known by your character.
SDP.Item.Talent.knowledgekeeper.Name: Keeper of Knowledge
SDP.Item.Talent.knowledgekeeper.Descript:
You know how to pass on your knowledge with confidence and clarity, which makes you particularly credible in the eyes of many interlocutors.

When you explain a subject you master, some people may take you at your word. If a Test is required, the GM may grant you a bonus to Charm Tests or Lore Tests involving social interaction, depending on the situation.
SDP.Item.Talent.nightowl.Name: Night Owl
SDP.Item.Talent.nightowl.Description:
You are accustomed to parties, taverns, and long nights. Your body has adapted to many substances that others would struggle to tolerate.

The GM may grant you a bonus to Toxin Resistance Tests when you consume alcohol, drugs, or other similar substances.
SDP.Item.Talent.linguistics.Name: Linguistics
SDP.Item.Talent.linguistics.Description:
You possess a natural affinity for languages and means of communication.

Even when you do not master a language, you find it easier to grasp its general meaning and make yourself understood. After a sufficient period of exposure and practice, the GM may consider that you have learned the corresponding Language Skill.
SDP.Item.Talent.magnumopus.Name: Magnum Opus
SDP.Item.Talent.magnumopus.Description:
You are recognized as a master in your field, capable of creating works that leave a lasting impression.

Each time you take this Talent, choose one of your Know-How Skills. You may then create an exceptional and unique work in that field. Those who know your creation are often impressed by your talent, which may grant you social advantages determined by the GM.

Note that no Test is required to succeed, but you may only create common objects related to that know-how.

If you decide to sell this work, it is generally worth at least ten times its normal value.
SDP.Item.Specie.human.Name: Human
SDP.Item.Specie.elf.Name: Elf
SDP.Item.Specie.dwarf.Name: Dwarf
SDP.Item.Sign.bull.Name: Bull
SDP.Item.Sign.bull.Description:
Those born under this sign are destined for battle. From an early age, they display unwavering determination, remarkable courage, and a natural affinity for the arts of war. Many of history's greatest warriors, champions, and conquerors are said to have been born beneath its influence.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of strength, discipline, and victory.
SDP.Item.Sign.bull.Level.1.Description: +1d4 damage on all Melee and Ranged tests based on Strength.
SDP.Item.Sign.bull.Level.4.Description: Your +1d4 damage increases to 1d6; in a Strength contest, you can use your entire body, granting +20 to the test.
SDP.Item.Sign.bull.Level.5.Description: +1d6 additional damage and +1d6 Wounds. Once per day, you may double the damage from your Strength bonus.
SDP.Item.Sign.unicorn.Name: Unicorn
SDP.Item.Sign.unicorn.Description:
Those born under this sign possess the most resolute spirits. Where others succumb to fear, corruption, or despair, the children of the Unicorn remain true to their convictions. Their will seems capable of repelling darkness itself, and many sages, mages, and spiritual guides are born beneath its influence.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of purity, wisdom, and inner strength.
SDP.Item.Sign.unicorn.Level.1.Descriptio: Automatically resist a psychological condition (exhausted, charmed, domination, corruption, etc.) once per day.
SDP.Item.Sign.unicorn.Level.4.Descriptio: Your willpower is so strong that you dominate any wild creature regardless of size (gain +60 to calm, frighten, or tame any animal).
SDP.Item.Sign.unicorn.Level.5.Descriptio: Your +1d4 spell damage increases to 1d8, and you gain +1d6 Wounds.
SDP.Item.Sign.bear.Name: Bear
SDP.Item.Sign.bear.Description:
Those born under this sign refuse to give up. Blessed with exceptional endurance, they withstand trials, wounds, and hardship where others would collapse. Survivors of the harshest lands and the most tireless travelers often bear the mark of the Bear.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of perseverance, resilience, and survival.
SDP.Item.Sign.bear.Level.4.Description: +1d6 Wounds when your HP drops below 50%; by spending 1 Determination, gain 2d6 temporary Wounds.
SDP.Item.Sign.bear.Level.5.Description: +2d6 Wounds. Once per day, you may take a hit and suffer only half its damage.
SDP.Item.Sign.dolphin.Name: Dolphin
SDP.Item.Sign.dolphin.Description:
Those born under this sign possess the keenest and most curious minds. Their ability to understand the world, solve riddles, and discover what escapes others often sets them apart from a young age. Scholars, inventors, and strategists count among the most famous children of the Dolphin.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of ingenuity, knowledge, and foresight.
SDP.Item.Sign.dolphin.Level.1.Descriptio: Once per session, you may reduce the negative consequences of an action you take (critical failure, softened fall, etc.).
SDP.Item.Sign.dolphin.Level.2.Descriptio: Once per session, you may make an unexpected connection (deduction). Ex.: this symbol = Cult X, this vial = poison, this mechanism is not used in current technology, etc.
SDP.Item.Sign.dolphin.Level.4.Descriptio: Complex planning: you may prepare a plan or action with your allies and gain +20 to execute that plan.
SDP.Item.Sign.dolphin.Level.5.Descriptio: Strategic genius: once per session, you may say "I had planned for that" and introduce a useful item, key information, etc. Ex.: I already studied this ritual, I have an antidote, etc.
SDP.Item.Sign.chimpanzee.Name: Chimpanzee
SDP.Item.Sign.chimpanzee.Description:
Those born under this sign seem guided by natural talent in their hands. Whether crafting, repairing, sculpting, or handling the most delicate objects, they learn with startling ease. The greatest artisans and creators are often born beneath the Chimpanzee's influence.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of skill, creativity, and adaptability.
SDP.Item.Sign.chimpanzee.Level.1.Descrip: You may reroll a Dexterity test once per day.
SDP.Item.Sign.chimpanzee.Level.2.Descrip: You can replicate a know-how skill simply by watching it; choose one know-how skill that can be integrated into all your careers.
SDP.Item.Sign.chimpanzee.Level.4.Descrip: Expert hand: choose between +20 to a Dex test, halve the time required, or add a narrative bonus (silent lockpicking, sturdier repair than expected, etc.).
SDP.Item.Sign.chimpanzee.Level.5.Descrip: Improved Magnus opus talent (ex.: weapon with a trait, tool with bonuses, object-related influence greatly increased).
SDP.Item.Sign.eagle.Name: Eagle
SDP.Item.Sign.eagle.Description:
Those born under this sign see before others do. Their vigilance and sharp instincts allow them to react with almost supernatural speed. Scouts, hunters, and explorers often say that children of the Eagle seem to perceive what escapes ordinary mortals.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of vigilance, instinct, and foresight.
SDP.Item.Sign.eagle.Level.1.Description: You always have the reaction advantage against others (on tied abilities, opposed Initiative test) and gain the Combat Speed talent.
SDP.Item.Sign.eagle.Level.4.Description: You can detect magic (granted as a level 1 talent) and always gain one extra clue on Perception tests, even on a failure (though it may be mixed with false information).
SDP.Item.Sign.eagle.Level.5.Description: Instinctive precognition: using all your senses at 200%, you may anticipate an attack and dodge it completely, whether melee, ranged, or magical.
SDP.Item.Sign.parrot.Name: Parrot
SDP.Item.Sign.parrot.Description:
Those born under this sign leave a mark with their words. Their natural ease, charm, and ability to understand others open many doors. Diplomats, negotiators, and leaders count among the most illustrious children of the Parrot.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of charisma, influence, and persuasion.
SDP.Item.Sign.parrot.Level.1.Description: Reroll one social test once per day.
SDP.Item.Sign.parrot.Level.2.Description: Ignore penalties related to social class, culture, etc.
SDP.Item.Sign.parrot.Level.4.Description: You project a commanding aura. On a social test that would normally be impossible (angry mob, "inevitable" fight), you may attempt it with +20 (subject to GM discretion).
SDP.Item.Sign.parrot.Level.5.Description: On a successful Charm/Calm test, you may confuse someone and give them a directive (simple order, force them to listen, temporarily turn a hostile person friendly, make them believe something).
SDP.Item.Sign.leopard.Name: Leopard
SDP.Item.Sign.leopard.Description:
Those born under this sign are not easily caught. Swift, agile, and graceful, they move with a fluidity that seems to defy the body's limits. The finest scouts, messengers, and acrobats often bear the mark of the Leopard.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of speed, freedom, and elegance.
SDP.Item.Sign.leopard.Level.1.Descriptio: You may disengage without spending an action if an ally is engaged with the creature pinning you. +1 Evasion to avoid opportunity attacks.
SDP.Item.Sign.leopard.Level.2.Descriptio: +1 MP and movement penalties from terrain (snow, mud, slopes) are less severe.
SDP.Item.Sign.leopard.Level.4.Descriptio: Enemies do not have time to react when you move, so you avoid opportunity attacks.
SDP.Item.Sign.leopard.Level.5.Descriptio: You are no longer subject to the rule that imposes penalties for each additional Dodge in the same turn.
SDP.Item.Sign.kangaroo.Name: Kangaroo
SDP.Item.Sign.kangaroo.Description:
Those born under this sign are the most technical fighters. Their mastery of the body and combat instinct allow them to adapt to every confrontation with remarkable efficiency. Many legendary weapon masters and duelists are born beneath the Kangaroo's influence.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of mastery, discipline, and martial excellence.
SDP.Item.Sign.kangaroo.Level.1.Descripti: You may make a double attack once per day against the same target.
SDP.Item.Sign.kangaroo.Level.2.Descripti: Choose any melee skill you do not yet have and integrate it into all your careers.
SDP.Item.Sign.kangaroo.Level.4.Descripti: You may make one additional double attack per day against two different targets.
SDP.Item.Sign.kangaroo.Level.5.Descripti: Once per day, your melee mastery lets you push your weapon to its limits, maximizing damage and ignoring armor.
SDP.Item.Sign.sagittarius.Name: Sagittarius
SDP.Item.Sign.sagittarius.Description:
Those born under this sign never waver in their aim. Blessed with remarkable precision and an innate sense of distance, they excel at hitting their target where others fail. History's greatest archers, marksmen, and hunters are said to be born beneath the Sagittarius's influence.

This sign is often regarded as an omen of precision, focus, and mastery.
SDP.Item.Sign.sagittarius.Level.1.Descri: Add +40 to one Ranged Ability test once per day.
SDP.Item.Sign.sagittarius.Level.2.Descri: Choose any projectile skill you do not yet have and integrate it into all your careers.
SDP.Item.Sign.sagittarius.Level.4.Descri: You may make a reload test and a shot in the same turn, or two shots in the same turn by spending all your MP.
SDP.Item.Sign.sagittarius.Level.5.Descri: Once per day, you may ignore the penalty for called shots, maximize weapon damage, and suffer no consequence to the weapon.

SDP.Item.Clothing.ordinaryclothes.Descri: A simple, modest set of clothes worn by most of the population (shoes, belt, top, and trousers).
SDP.Item.Clothing.wornclothes.Name: Worn clothes
SDP.Item.Clothing.wornclothes.Descriptio:

They are typically worn by people with little means, such as peasants, beggars, laborers, or penniless travelers.

SDP.Item.Container.handcart.Name: Handcart
SDP.Item.Container.handcart.Description:
This small handcart is designed to transport goods, equipment, or supplies over short and medium distances. It may be pulled by hand or hitched to a mule, donkey, or any other suitable draft animal.

Simple but sturdy, it is commonly used by merchants, artisans, travelers, and farmers to move loads too cumbersome to carry on one's back.
SDP.Item.Container.riverboat.Name: River transport boat
SDP.Item.Container.riverboat.Description: Large transport boat capable of carrying many goods or passengers. Designed to navigate rivers, streams, and along coastlines.
SDP.Item.Container.boat.Name: Boat
SDP.Item.Container.boat.Description: A light rowboat or sailboat suited to rivers, lakes, and calm coastal waters. Can carry a few people and a modest load.
SDP.Item.Container.skiff.Name: Skiff
SDP.Item.Container.wagon.Name: Wagons
SDP.Item.Container.wagon.Description:
Transport wagon requiring two draft animals to move.

Used to carry goods, equipment, or passengers over long distances.
SDP.Item.Container.stagecoach.Name: Stagecoach
SDP.Item.Container.carriage.Name: Carriage
SDP.Item.Container.carriage.Description: An enclosed horse-drawn vehicle designed for the comfortable transport of one or more passengers. Often used by nobles, diplomats, and high-ranking figures on official journeys.

SDP.Item.Possession.grimoire.Description: A compendium of fundamental magical knowledge, including the principles of one school of magic and several spells.
SDP.Item.Possession.blankgrimoire.Name: Blank grimoire
SDP.Item.Possession.abacus.Name: Abacus
SDP.Item.Possession.abacus.Description: A simple tool used by merchants to keep their accounts, check their merchandise, and manage their daily transactions.
SDP.Item.Possession.guildlicense.Name: Guild license
SDP.Item.Possession.guildlicense.Descrip:
Official document certifying a person's skills in a particular field.

It is generally required to practice certain professions or to prove one's expertise to others.

SDP.Item.Possession.hunterlicense.Name: Hunter license
SDP.Item.Possession.omiralicense.Name: Omira license
SDP.Item.Possession.warehouse.Name: Warehouse
SDP.Item.Possession.warehouse.Descriptio: Spacious storage building used to keep merchandise, raw materials, or finished goods. Very useful to merchants, prosperous artisans, and large producers.
SDP.Item.Possession.manor.Name: Manor
SDP.Item.Possession.manor.Description: The base price of a manor can quickly increase depending on the manor.

SDP.Item.Possession.smallestate.Name: Small estate
SDP.Item.Possession.smallestate.Descript: A modest agricultural holding comprising a dwelling, arable land, and sometimes a few livestock buildings. Enough to feed a family and produce a limited surplus.

SDP.Item.Possession.stormlantern.Descrip: Provides light to 20 meters and withstands all weather conditions.

SDP.Item.Injury.lightBody.Description: −10 penalty to MA, RA, Strength and Agility for 1d4 rounds.

SDP.Item.Injury.lightArm.Description: −10 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, MA and RA on the affected arm for 1d4 rounds.

SDP.Item.Injury.lightArmConsequence.Desc: Drops the object held in hand.
SDP.Item.Injury.lightHead.Name: Light head injury
SDP.Item.Injury.lightHead.Description: −10 penalty to Intelligence, Willpower, Charisma and Initiative for 1d4 rounds.
SDP.Item.Injury.lightLeg.Name: Light leg injury
SDP.Item.Injury.lightLeg.Description: −10 penalty to Strength, MA and Agility and −1 to Movement for 1d4 rounds.
SDP.Item.Injury.lightLegConsequence.Name: Light leg injury (consequence)
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateArm.Name: Moderate arm injury
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateArm.Description:
−20 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, MA and RA on the affected arm for 1d8 rounds.
Then Fatigue and Bleeding: −1 Health per round.
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateArmConsequence.D:
Drops the object held in hand and imposes an additional −20 penalty to all actions requiring use of that hand until healed (−10 for two-handed actions).
Also Shaken.
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateHead.Name: Moderate head injury
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateHead.Description:
−20 penalty to Intelligence, Willpower, Charisma and Initiative for 1d8 rounds.
Then Fatigue and Bleeding: −1 Health per round.
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateBody.Name: Moderate torso injury
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateBody.Description:
−20 penalty to Strength, Agility, MA and RA for 1d8 rounds.
Then Fatigue and Bleeding: −1 Health per round.
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateLeg.Name: Moderate leg injury
SDP.Item.Injury.moderateLeg.Description:
−20 penalty to Strength, MA and Agility and −2 to Movement for 1d8 rounds.
Then Fatigue and Bleeding: −1 Health per round.
SDP.Item.Injury.severeArm.Name: Severe arm injury
SDP.Item.Injury.severeArm.Description:
−40 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, MA and RA on the affected arm until healed.
1 Fatigue and 2 Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.severeArmConsequence.Des:
Permanent −10 reduction to Strength, Dexterity, MA and RA. That hand cannot be used and imposes an additional −40 penalty to all two-handed actions.
1 Stunned and Shaken additionally.
SDP.Item.Injury.severeHead.Name: Severe head injury
SDP.Item.Injury.severeHead.Description:
−40 penalty to Intelligence, Willpower, Charisma and Initiative until healed.
1 Fatigue and 2 Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.severeHeadConsequence.De:
Permanent −10 reduction to Intelligence, Willpower, Charisma and Initiative. Also falls unconscious for 1d8 rounds.
1 Stunned and Shaken additionally.
SDP.Item.Injury.severeBody.Name: Severe torso injury
SDP.Item.Injury.severeBody.Description:
−40 penalty to Strength, Agility, MA and RA until healed.
1 Fatigue and 2 Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.severeBodyConsequence.De:
Permanent −10 reduction to Strength, Agility, MA and RA.
1 Stunned and Shaken additionally.
SDP.Item.Injury.severeLeg.Name: Severe leg injury
SDP.Item.Injury.severeLeg.Description:
−40 penalty to Strength, MA and Agility and −4 to Movement until healed.
1 Fatigue and 2 Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.severeLegConsequence.Des:
Permanent −10 reduction to Strength, MA and Agility and −4 to Movement; also gains the Prone condition and can no longer run.
1 Stunned and Shaken additionally.
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalArm.Name: Critical arm injury
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalArm.Description:
−60 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, MA and RA on the affected arm until healed. Drops the weapon held in hand.
1 Exhausted and 3 Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalArmConsequence.D:
Permanent −20 reduction to Strength, Dexterity, MA and RA. That arm cannot be used and imposes an additional permanent −40 penalty to all two-handed actions.
Unconscious for 1d12 then Frightened until healed.
2 additional Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalHead.Name: Critical head injury
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalHead.Description:
−60 penalty to Intelligence, Initiative, Willpower and Charisma until healed. Unconscious for 1d12.
1 Exhausted and 3 Bleeding.
Permanent −20 reduction to Intelligence, Initiative, Willpower and Charisma.
Unconscious for 1d12 then Frightened until healed.
2 additional Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalBody.Name: Critical torso injury
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalBody.Description:
−60 penalty to Strength, Agility, MA and RA until healed.
1 Exhausted and 3 Bleeding.
Permanent −20 reduction to Strength, Agility, MA and RA.
Unconscious for 1d12 then Frightened until healed.
2 additional Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalLeg.Name: Critical leg injury
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalLeg.Description:
−60 penalty to Agility, Strength, MA and −6 to Movement until healed. Falls prone.
1 Exhausted and 3 Bleeding.
SDP.Item.Injury.criticalLegConsequence.D:
Permanent −20 reduction to Agility, Strength, MA and −2 to Movement.
Unconscious for 1d12 then Frightened until healed.
2 additional Bleeding.
